table.en: The results are organized in a table for easy comparison.
table.zh: 結果整理在表格中，方便比較。

take.en: Please take notes while you listen to the presentation.

talk.en: We need to talk about how to divide the work fairly.
talk.zh: 我們需要討論如何公平分配工作。

task.en: Each student received a different task for the group project.
task.zh: 每位學生在小組專題中都分到不同任務。

teach.en: Good examples can teach difficult ideas more effectively than definitions alone.
teach.zh: 好的例子往往比單靠定義更能教會困難觀念。

teacher.en: The teacher explained the instructions before the activity began.
teacher.zh: 活動開始前，老師先說明了指示。

team.en: The team worked together to solve the problem before class ended.
team.zh: 團隊合作在下課前解決了問題。

technology.en: Technology has changed how students access information and communicate.
technology.zh: 科技改變了學生取得資訊與溝通的方式。

telephone.en: The office telephone rang several times during the meeting.
telephone.zh: 會議期間辦公室電話響了好幾次。

television.en: The documentary was shown on national television last night.
television.zh: 這部紀錄片昨晚在全國電視台播出。

tell.en: Please tell the group what you observed during the experiment.
tell.zh: 請告訴小組你在實驗中觀察到的現象。

temperature.en: The temperature dropped quickly after the sun went down.
temperature.zh: 太陽下山後，氣溫快速下降。

term.en: The teacher defined the new term before using it in discussion.
term.zh: 老師在討論中使用新術語前先加以定義。

test.en: The test includes reading, vocabulary, and short writing questions.
test.zh: 這份測驗包含閱讀、單字和短文寫作題。

text.en: Read the text carefully before answering the questions below.
text.zh: 回答下方問題前請仔細閱讀文章。

than.en: This method is faster than the one we used yesterday.
than.zh: 這個方法比我們昨天使用的方法更快。

thank.en: We should thank the volunteers for helping with the event.
thank.zh: 我們應該感謝志工協助這場活動。

that.en: The evidence shows that the new method is more effective.
that.zh: 證據顯示新方法更有效。

the.en: The students entered the classroom quietly before the test.
the.zh: 學生在考試前安靜地進入教室。

their.en: The students presented their findings to the whole class.
their.zh: 學生向全班報告他們的研究結果。

them.en: The teacher gave them extra time to finish the assignment.
them.zh: 老師給他們更多時間完成作業。

then.en: Read the instructions first, then begin the experiment.
then.zh: 先閱讀說明，接著再開始實驗。

theory.en: The experiment was designed to test a simple scientific theory.
theory.zh: 這個實驗是為了檢驗一項簡單的科學理論。

there.en: There are several possible answers to this question.
there.zh: 這個問題有好幾種可能的答案。

therefore.en: The data was incomplete; therefore, we delayed the final decision.
therefore.zh: 資料不完整，因此我們延後了最後決定。

these.en: These examples show how the rule works in different situations.
these.zh: 這些例子顯示這項規則在不同情況下如何運作。

they.en: They reviewed the report together before submitting it.
they.zh: 他們在提交報告前一起檢查內容。

thick.en: The book has a thick cover that protects the pages well.
thick.zh: 這本書有厚實的封面，能很好地保護書頁。

thin.en: A thin layer of ice formed on the water overnight.
thin.zh: 夜裡水面形成了一層薄冰。

thing.en: The most important thing is to understand why the answer is correct.
thing.zh: 最重要的是理解答案為什麼正確。

think.en: Take a moment to think before choosing your final answer.
think.zh: 選擇最後答案前先花一點時間思考。

third.en: The team finished third in the regional competition.
third.zh: 這支隊伍在地區比賽中獲得第三名。

this.en: This chart compares the results from three different classes.
this.zh: 這張圖表比較三個不同班級的結果。

those.en: Those students volunteered to help clean the school grounds.
those.zh: 那些學生自願幫忙清理校園。

though.en: Though the task was difficult, everyone completed it on time.
though.zh: 雖然任務很難，每個人仍準時完成。

thought.en: She gave careful thought to each option before deciding.
thought.zh: 她在做決定前仔細考慮了每個選項。

thousand.en: More than a thousand people attended the festival this year.
thousand.zh: 今年有超過一千人參加這場節慶活動。

three.en: The experiment was repeated three times to confirm the result.
three.zh: 這個實驗重複了三次，以確認結果。

through.en: We walked through the park on our way to the station.
through.zh: 我們前往車站途中穿過了公園。

throughout.en: The weather remained cool throughout the entire weekend.
throughout.zh: 整個週末天氣都維持涼爽。

throw.en: Please do not throw paper into the wrong recycling bin.
throw.zh: 請不要把紙丟進錯誤的回收桶。

Thursday.en: The project meeting has been moved to Thursday afternoon.
Thursday.zh: 專題會議改到星期四下午。

ticket.en: Keep your ticket until you leave the station.
ticket.zh: 離開車站前請保留車票。

time.en: Good time management can reduce stress before major exams.
time.zh: 良好的時間管理能減少大考前的壓力。

tiny.en: A tiny crack appeared near the edge of the glass.
tiny.zh: 玻璃邊緣出現了一道很小的裂痕。

title.en: Choose a clear title that matches the main idea of your report.
title.zh: 請選一個符合報告主旨的清楚標題。

to.en: Students went to the library to prepare for the exam.
to.zh: 學生去圖書館準備考試。

today.en: We will review the most important vocabulary today.
today.zh: 我們今天會複習最重要的單字。

together.en: The two groups worked together to complete the final presentation.
together.zh: 兩個小組合作完成了最後報告。

tomorrow.en: Please bring your completed worksheet to class tomorrow.
tomorrow.zh: 明天上課請帶完成的學習單。

tonight.en: I plan to review the chapter again tonight.
tonight.zh: 我今晚打算再複習一次這一章。

too.en: The box is too heavy for one person to carry safely.
too.zh: 這個箱子太重，一個人搬並不安全。

tool.en: A calculator is a useful tool for checking numerical results.
tool.zh: 計算機是檢查數值結果的實用工具。

topic.en: Each group selected a different topic for its presentation.
topic.zh: 每個小組都選了不同的報告主題。

total.en: The total cost was lower than our original estimate.

touch.en: Do not touch the equipment until the teacher gives permission.
touch.zh: 在老師允許前不要碰設備。

tour.en: The museum tour lasted about ninety minutes.
tour.zh: 博物館導覽大約持續九十分鐘。

toward.en: The students walked toward the gym after lunch.
toward.zh: 午餐後學生朝體育館走去。

town.en: The small town is famous for its old streets and local food.
town.zh: 這座小鎮以老街和在地美食聞名。

track.en: The app can track your study progress over time.
track.zh: 這個應用程式可以追蹤你的學習進度。

trade.en: International trade allows countries to exchange goods and services.
trade.zh: 國際貿易讓各國能交換商品與服務。

traditional.en: The festival includes traditional music, food, and local performances.
traditional.zh: 這場節慶包含傳統音樂、美食和在地表演。

traffic.en: Heavy traffic caused many students to arrive late.
traffic.zh: 交通壅塞造成許多學生遲到。

train.en: We took the train because it was faster than driving.
train.zh: 我們搭火車，因為比開車快。

training.en: Regular training helped the team improve its performance.
training.zh: 規律訓練幫助球隊提升表現。

transportation.en: Public transportation can reduce the number of cars on busy roads.
transportation.zh: 大眾運輸能減少繁忙道路上的汽車數量。

travel.en: Many students travel during vacation to experience different cultures.
travel.zh: 許多學生在假期旅行，體驗不同文化。

treat.en: Doctors treat different illnesses with different methods.
treat.zh: 醫師使用不同方法治療不同疾病。

treatment.en: The patient responded well to the new treatment.
treatment.zh: 這位病人對新的治療反應良好。

tree.en: The old tree provides shade beside the school playground.
tree.zh: 這棵老樹在學校操場旁提供樹蔭。

trend.en: The graph shows a clear upward trend over five years.
trend.zh: 這張圖表顯示五年間明顯的上升趨勢。

trial.en: The first trial produced unexpected results, so we repeated the test.
trial.zh: 第一次試驗出現意外結果，因此我們重做測試。

trip.en: The class trip helped students learn outside the classroom.
trip.zh: 班級旅行幫助學生在課堂外學習。

trouble.en: Please ask for help if you have trouble understanding the instructions.
trouble.zh: 如果你在理解說明上遇到困難，請尋求幫助。

true.en: The statement is true only under certain conditions.
true.zh: 這個敘述只有在特定條件下才成立。

trust.en: Good teamwork depends on communication and mutual trust.
trust.zh: 良好的團隊合作仰賴溝通與彼此信任。

truth.en: The investigation tried to discover the truth behind the report.
truth.zh: 調查試圖找出這份報告背後的真相。

try.en: If the first method fails, try a different approach.
try.zh: 如果第一種方法失敗，就試試不同方式。

Tuesday.en: Our English test will take place next Tuesday morning.
Tuesday.zh: 我們的英文考試會在下星期二早上舉行。

turn.en: Please turn the page and read the next paragraph.

type.en: This type of question requires careful reading of the passage.
type.zh: 這種類型的題目需要仔細閱讀文章。

typical.en: This is a typical example of how the pattern appears.
typical.zh: 這是這種模式出現方式的典型例子。

under.en: The books are stored under the desk near the window.

understand.en: It is easier to remember a word when you understand its meaning.
understand.zh: 理解單字意思後會比較容易記住。

understanding.en: The discussion improved our understanding of the main issue.
understanding.zh: 這場討論加深了我們對主要議題的理解。

unit.en: The next unit focuses on environmental problems and solutions.
unit.zh: 下一單元著重環境問題與解決方法。

university.en: She hopes to study engineering at university in the future.
university.zh: 她希望未來在大學就讀工程相關科系。

unless.en: You cannot enter the laboratory unless a teacher is present.
unless.zh: 除非有老師在場，否則不能進入實驗室。

until.en: We stayed in the library until it closed.
until.zh: 我們待在圖書館直到關門。

up.en: Please look up the unfamiliar word in a dictionary.
up.zh: 請在字典中查這個不熟悉的單字。

update.en: The website will update the information automatically every morning.
update.zh: 網站每天早上會自動更新資訊。

upon.en: Upon arrival, students must report to the main office.
upon.zh: 抵達後，學生必須先到總務辦公室報到。

upper.en: The upper floor of the library is reserved for quiet study.
upper.zh: 圖書館樓上樓層保留作安靜自習使用。

urban.en: Urban areas often face challenges related to traffic and housing.
urban.zh: 都市地區常面臨交通和住房相關挑戰。

use.en: Students can use this website to review vocabulary at home.
use.zh: 學生可以在家使用這個網站複習單字。

useful.en: The chart provides useful information for comparing the two groups.
useful.zh: 這張圖表提供比較兩組時很有用的資訊。

user.en: Each user must create an account before saving progress.
user.zh: 每位使用者都必須先建立帳號才能儲存進度。

usual.en: The library is quieter than usual during the school holiday.
usual.zh: 學校放假期間圖書館比平常安靜。

usually.en: I usually review new vocabulary before going to bed.
usually.zh: 我通常在睡前複習新單字。
